hero.eyebrow: Meal vouchers and employee benefits · Tunisia
hero.title: We opened the last book of vouchers.
hero.text: FlexiPay replaces paper vouchers with credits on the phone: meals, clothing, fuel and gifts. Tear off the vouchers to see how it works.

types.title: Four credit types, one balance each
types.text: Each type has its own balance, merchants and rules. No transfer between types.

company.title: Companies
company.p1: Credit orders per type, paid by bank transfer.
company.p2: Allocation in a few clicks or by CSV file.

merchant.title: Merchants
merchant.p1: Collect by code or QR, with no terminal.
merchant.p2: Settlement at D+2, commission known in advance.
merchant.p3: History, receivables and payouts in one place.

employee.title: Beneficiaries
employee.p1: One balance per type, always up to date.
employee.p3: Receipt and history of every operation.

s1.title: The company credits
s1.text: It orders credits per type, pays them by transfer, then allocates them to its employees.

s2.title: The beneficiary pays
s2.text: They show their QR code to the merchant or scan the merchant’s, then confirm with their PIN.

s3.title: The merchant is settled
s3.text: Confirmed payments are transferred at D+2, commission deducted.

footer.country: Service operated in Tunisia, amounts in dinars (TND).

t1.title: A company orders its credits
t1.text: It chooses the amounts per type and makes a transfer. FlexiPay checks, then credits. No book to print, no courier.
t1.fine: Do not throw this voucher away: it is made of pixels.

t2.title: It shares them with its teams
t2.text: In a few clicks, or by file for 500 people at once. Everyone gets their balances, split by type.
t2.fine: Never again “I am missing a book”.

t3.title: The beneficiary pays with the phone
t3.text: They show their code to the merchant and confirm with their PIN. The exact amount, to the millime.

t4.title: The merchant is paid at D+2
t4.text: Payments add up on their own. The merchant requests the transfer, the commission is already computed.
t4.fine: No more counting vouchers at night.

t5.title: That was the last paper voucher
t5.text: The book is empty. The rest happens on FlexiPay: join us or slip us a contact voucher.
t5.fine: End of the book. Start of FlexiPay.

forWho.title: One book, three ways to use it

company.title: You offer
company.text: Order credits by transfer, share them between your teams by type, and follow everything in real time. No more books to hand out on the 1st of the month.

employee.title: You enjoy
employee.text: Your balances per type on your phone. Show your code, type your PIN, it is paid. To the millime, without change given in sweets.

merchant.title: You collect
merchant.text: A QR at the till, a payment confirmed in seconds, a transfer at D+2. No more vouchers to count at night or to drop at the bank.
